name: @lastthaw/mapgen
description: One-time world map generator for Last Thaw (Natural Earth admin-1 -> ~400 regions)

scripts.generate: tsx src/generate.ts && tsx src/anchors.ts && tsx src/extents.ts
scripts.pangaea: tsx src/generate-pangaea.ts && node src/dense-lanes.mjs --map=pangaea && node src/sea-paths.mjs --map=pangaea && node ../unit-pictures/coast-points.mjs ../../packages/shared/src/map/pangaea.json ../../apps/web/public/map/pangaea/coastPoints.json && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('../../packages/shared/src/map/pangaea.json','../../apps/web/public/map/pangaea/world.json')"
